# synthetic-data

> Seeded synthetic tabular data from a declarative schema: ten column types, uniqueness, nullability, foreign keys across tables and CSV or JSONL export Python package `trysac-synthetic-data`, import name `synthetic_data`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
